name: Suzunami Hinata
source:
Childhood friend of the main character “Kazunari”. She has always loved Kazunari. She has an innocent personality and tells him “Love” in a straightforward manner. 

She runs a guest house and a beach house with her mother, Kanako.

[From [url=https://www.ammolite-game.com/amml_037/amml_037.html#link_character]official site[/url]]
